# Docker images the integration tests pin. The tests read floci/floci, floci/floci-az and
# floci/floci-gcp from here (the images_test.go of flociaws, flociaz and flocigcp) and CI pulls
# every line, so each tag is declared once. One image:tag per line; '#' comments and blank lines
# are ignored. The library defaults stay the floating latest tag of each image; the examples use
# it too, as user-facing code.
floci/floci:2.2.0
floci/floci-az:0.14.0
floci/floci-gcp:0.10.0
